title: Quest text said plainly 'Captain Vane will trade the smugglers' road for coin, or for Rook dealt with. Ask her.' After Rook was dealt with peacefully and I asked, she instead said the Companies 'don't sell the road on one favour to a stranger' and demanded an unspecified further good turn - the stated condition wasn't honored.
where: Captain Vane's Tent - 'the road, now Rook's dealt with'
